name: ideogram-mcp
description: Ideogram (builder tools): me, generate_image, get_job, list_items, get_item. Every tool maps to a do

platform_mcp_ideogram_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_IDEOGRAM_API_KEY
platform_mcp_ideogram_api_key.description: Ideogram API key (developer.ideogram.ai > API dashboard, after adding a payment method and credits), sent as the Api-Key header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /models?scope=owned: the key's own custom models; used as a credential check (there is no account endpoint).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /generate {image_request: {prompt, negative_prompt, aspect_ratio, model, seed, resolution}} (the JSON generate endpoint, listed under Legacy Endpoints) -> {data: [{url, seed, resolution, is_image_safe}]}, synchronous. aspect_ratio uses Ideogram enums (ASPECT_16_9, ASPECT_1_1 …), model V_2, V_2_TURBO, V_2A, V_3 … (default V_2); size is a resolution enum such as RESOLUTION_1024_1024 and cannot be combined with aspect_ratio. The Ideogram 3.0/4.0 endpoints take multipart/form-data and are not mapped.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: GET /v1/generations/{generation_id}: status pending|completed|failed of an asynchronous generation (the Ideogram 4.0 async endpoints return the generation_id); once completed data[] carries the image/video URLs (all in raw.data).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /models: custom models owned by or shared with the key (items are models; custom_model_uri is what generation takes). Not paginated.
